data.narrative:
Focused Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Thomas Forner and Markus Roth that has raised $240M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 11 total companies—three public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and eight private peers in the nuclear energy sector at similar or adjacent stages, including Valar Atomics, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, Oklo, and X-Energy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using $240M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yields $480M. The peer-median approach considers three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Valar Atomics at $6.0B (Series B), Nano Nuclear Energy at $808M (Seed), and Fuse Energy at $200M (Series A). The median across these three peers is $808M, with a range spanning $200M to $6.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $408M (low), $644M (median), and $929M (high). The $221M spread between low and high reflects material uncertainty inherent in stage-progression assumptions and the wide dispersion among peer valuations, particularly the 30x differential between Fuse Energy and Valar Atomics. Key sensitivities include stage-up multiplier selection and the heterogeneity of peer capital efficiency and technology maturity within the nuclear energy cohort.
